boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-Northridge
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Northridge food destinations with late availability verified on current official location or business pages.

cards.title: Chicken Fingers After 3 A.M.
cards.subtitle: Business Center Drive, west of the CSUN campus
cards.notes: Use this for the latest verified dine-in window on the board; check the official location page before heading west from campus.
cards.short_summary: A Northridge chicken-finger restaurant with exceptionally late dine-in and drive-through service.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page identifies the restaurant at 19310 Business Center Drive and lists dine-in and drive-through hours until 3:30 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 4:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours show both dine-in and drive-through until 3:30 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 4:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; recheck before departure.

cards.title: A Drive-Through Open Until 3 A.M.
cards.subtitle: Parthenia Street near Reseda Boulevard
cards.notes: Choose the drive-through after the dining room closes, and confirm the day’s schedule on the official page before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent fast-food option whose drive-through runs later than its dining room.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page lists drive-through hours until 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 18100 Parthenia Street.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Northridge, California — 18100 Parthenia St
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the official page shows earlier dine-in closing times.

cards.title: A Round-the-Clock Diner Stop
cards.subtitle: Tampa Avenue beside Northridge Fashion Center
cards.notes: Head here when a sit-down meal matters more than the clock; the official page welcomes walk-ins and confirms continuous service.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour family diner serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner at any hour.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official location page lists the 9001 Tampa Avenue restaurant as open 24 hours every day, with walk-ins welcome and service suitable for kids.
cards.access_notes: The official restaurant schedule says open 24 hours Monday through Sunday; contact the location to confirm holiday exceptions.

cards.title: Pancakes at Any Hour
cards.subtitle: Tampa Avenue near Northridge Fashion Center
cards.notes: Use the all-day dining room for a late sit-down option; verify the live location page if traveling during a holiday period.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour pancake restaurant with dine-in, takeout, and online ordering listed.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's official late-night page lists the 9012 Tampa Avenue restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday and identifies dine-in and takeout amenities.
cards.source_title: Northridge Late Night Food — IHOP at 9012 Tampa Ave
cards.access_notes: The official page lists this restaurant as open 24 hours every day, with dine-in, online ordering, takeout, and delivery among its amenities.

cards.title: Burgers Until 1:30 A.M.
cards.subtitle: Tampa Avenue south of Nordhoff Street
cards.notes: Pick this location for verified late dine-in seating, and allow extra travel time from campus before the posted closing hour.
cards.short_summary: A late-closing burger restaurant with both drive-through and indoor seating.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out's official location page lists drive-through and dine-in seating and normal hours until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Normal hours are 10:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in and drive-through are listed.

cards.title: Thai Food Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: Reseda Boulevard south of Nordhoff Street
cards.notes: Plan this for Thursday through Saturday, when the restaurant directly advertises its later window; order ahead if timing is tight.
cards.short_summary: A named Northridge Thai restaurant advertising midnight service on three nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Lum-Ka-Naad's official website identifies its Northridge restaurant at 8910 Reseda Boulevard and states that all locations are open until midnight Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant's official site advertises late opening until midnight Thursday–Saturday; verify the current schedule before traveling.

cards.title: A Midnight-to-1 A.M. Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: Devonshire Street north of the CSUN campus
cards.notes: Use Thursday through Saturday for the latest posted closing time; the official schedule shows both restaurant and drive-through hours.
cards.short_summary: A north-of-campus fast-food stop open later on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official page lists restaurant and drive-through service until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and until 1:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through hours run until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and 1:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday, according to the official page.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box at 11216 Tampa Avenue
cards.title: A Drive-Through Until 2 A.M.
cards.subtitle: Tampa Avenue in northern Northridge
cards.notes: Treat this as a drive-through run after 11 p.m., because the official page shows the lobby closing earlier than vehicle service.
cards.short_summary: A northern Northridge option with drive-through service extending beyond lobby hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box's official page lists drive-through hours until 2:00 a.m. Monday–Saturday and 1:00 a.m. Sunday, while the lobby closes at 11:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 11216 Tampa Ave, Northridge
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 2:00 a.m. Monday–Saturday and 1:00 a.m. Sunday; the official listing shows the lobby closing at 11:00 p.m.

cards.title: A Friday-and-Saturday 1 A.M. Stop
cards.subtitle: Roscoe Boulevard east of Reseda Boulevard
cards.notes: Save this run for Friday or Saturday to use the later posted window; restaurant and drive-through schedules match on the official page.
cards.short_summary: A Northridge McDonald's open one hour later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official location page lists restaurant, lobby, and drive-through hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant and drive-through hours end at midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; verify holiday hours separately.

cards.title: Tacos Through Midnight
cards.subtitle: Corbin Avenue south of Nordhoff Street
cards.notes: Use this as a straightforward midnight pickup or delivery option, checking the official location page before placing a late order.
cards.short_summary: A Northridge taco restaurant listing store and delivery service through midnight daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco's official page identifies the restaurant at 8941 Corbin Avenue and lists both store and delivery hours through midnight every day.
cards.source_title: Del Taco in Northridge, California — 8941 Corbin Ave
cards.access_notes: The official page lists store and delivery service until midnight Monday through Sunday; opening times differ on weekends.
